Str.Help.SubSource.Title: Subtitle sources
Str.Help.SubSource.Body:
Off: play only — no source extraction, MT, or online search.
Online: search SubtitleCat / Xunlei by title; no auto source extraction on failure.
Local: sidecar .srt / .ass only; no auto source extraction if missing.
Live subtitles: optional sidecar first, otherwise auto source extraction (default path).
Str.Help.Shortcuts.Body:
Open Ctrl+O · stream Ctrl+Shift+O · Play/Pause Space · Seek ← →
Fine Shift+←→ · Large Ctrl+←→ · ±60s PageUp/Down
Start/End Home/End · Frame , .
Volume ↑↓ · wheel · fine seek Shift+wheel
ZH/Src/Dual 1/2/3 · toggle subs V/0 · sync Z/X ±0.5s
Playlist L · prev/next P/N · mute M · screenshot S · clip C
speed [ / ] · fullscreen F/F11/Enter · top T · help F1
Str.Settings.WaitZh.HintLong: For viewers who prefer not to start with source only; long files may wait longer. Use 「Play now」 or Space during wait. English shows usually play immediately without waiting for Chinese.
Str.Settings.Subtitle.PreviewHint: Approximate look while adjusting size, outline, and margin (mpv renders the real output).
Str.Settings.PreferExternal: Prefer sidecar subtitles (.srt / .ass); skip auto ASR
Str.Settings.AutoPreview: Auto-start ASR when no sidecar exists
Str.Settings.Translate: Translation: use local model when available; otherwise source first
Str.Settings.TranslateTarget.Hint: Defaults follow the UI language; change anytime. Simplified/Traditional/en/ja/ko share one translation model, not in the default pack.
Str.TranslateModel.TranslateGemma.Hint: Default MT model (~2.5 GB); live subtitles, multi-language.
Str.TranslateModel.Murasaki.Hint: ACGN JA→Chinese (~2.5 GB); JA→ZH/ZH-Hant only; CoT off for live subtitles.

Str.Settings.WaitFirstZh: Wait longer: don't play until translation reaches target duration
Str.Settings.PlayImmediatelyOnOpen: Play immediately on open (don't wait for translation)
Str.Settings.PlayImmediatelyOnOpen.Hint: By default, Translation/Bilingual mode pauses until the first translated cues are ready. Check this to play immediately (source shown while translation catches up).
Str.Settings.WaitZh.DepHint: Requires translation, auto source extraction, auto-play on open, and default mode Translation/Bilingual. Unless 「Play immediately」 is checked, open waits for the first translated batch; check the option below to wait longer.
Str.Settings.LockAspect.Hint: Keep picture aspect while dragging window edges. Uses the video aspect when available; ignored in fullscreen or maximized.
Str.Settings.AddSameFolderToPlaylist: Add other media in the same folder when opening one file
Str.Settings.AddSameFolderToPlaylist.Hin: Applies when you open or pick a single file only; multi-select, Shift+append, and playlist files are unchanged. Sorted by file name; current file first.
Str.Settings.HideChrome: Auto-hide controls in fullscreen (move mouse to bottom edge)
Str.Settings.Playback.Hint: Playback on open, fullscreen chrome, seek steps, and video scaling.
Str.Settings.PrefetchPlaylist: Prefetch subtitles for upcoming playlist items
Str.Settings.PrefetchPlaylist.Hint: When the playlist has multiple files, prefetch runs after the current item; opening next may reuse cached subtitles. Skips when auto ASR is off, or when Prefer sidecar finds a local subtitle.
Str.Settings.RememberPos: Remember playback position (ask to jump on next open)
Str.Settings.Playback.AdvancedHint: Hardware decode writes to mpv immediately; reopen the file if the picture does not switch. 「Fit window to video」 resizes on open (1:1 pixels, clamped to screen; skipped when maximized/fullscreen).
Str.Settings.Subtitle.Hint: Subtitle appearance and sync. Source extraction toggles are under General.
Str.Settings.SubDelayHint: Positive = later. Nudge during playback with Z / X ±0.5s.
Str.Settings.Glossary: Glossary path (empty = data/glossary.json or local Transub)
Str.Settings.Advanced.Hint: Recognition always uses the bundled lite engine (whisper turbo, on-demand). The Transub install folder below is only for production handoff and reusing translation models / glossaries / lexicons.
Str.Settings.Advanced.CheckUpdatesOnStar: Check for updates on startup (about once a day)
Str.Settings.Advanced.UpdateHint: Builds are published to GitHub / GitCode Releases. Portable builds can replace files and restart; installed builds should use the setup installer; a dev build only opens the releases page.
Str.Settings.Advanced.TransubDirHint: Pick the folder containing Transub.exe; used for handoff and asset reuse — not as the recognition engine.
Str.Settings.Advanced.TransubDirInvalid: Not a Transub install folder. Choose a folder with Transub.exe (or shared / advanced-llm).
Str.Settings.TransubReuse.None: No local Transub found; Player can install lexicons and translation models on demand.
Str.Settings.TransubReuse.FoundIdle: Found Transub ({0}); not currently reusing its assets.
Str.Settings.Paths.Hint: Files are large (ASR ~1 GB, translation ~2.5 GB). Prefer a non-system drive. Leave empty for Player defaults; existing usable files in the folder are not reinstalled.
Str.Settings.Presets.EnMtHint: English series/film: EN→ZH uses TranslateGemma 4B (~2.5 GB), same model as other directions.
Str.Settings.Presets.EnOutHint: EN translation (JA/KO/ZH…): uses the same TranslateGemma 4B model (~2.5 GB).
Str.Settings.Advanced.PackHint: Missing ASR/translation models prompt install. GPU and translation packs need not ship in the default install.
